reuse.why: Adds the guard inside the existing linkBankSyncAccount funnel that every provider's link handler already goes through, using the existing db.first query helper.

duplication.why: A single check serves all five providers; nothing is copied per provider.

placement.why: The rule sits at the top of the shared link function in accounts/app.ts, before any write or sync, matching where that file already queries accounts.

scope.why: Only the guard and its tests are added.

maintainability.why: Short, self-explanatory check in the one place linking happens, covered by focused tests.

one_place.where: linkBankSyncAccount in packages/loot-core/src/server/accounts/app.ts, called by all *-accounts-link handlers
